item: Existing YAM bench with two stock arms and wrist/overview cameras
specification: Use stock YAM station with 1100×1300 tabletop and manufacturer base mounts. Equipment supplied by host. Confirm supported weight of attachments.
Polypropylene inside clear 650×770×20 mm or heat-weld from 3 mm sheet. A flat sealed panel supports any rim overhang. Verify 750 mL spill with stands fitted.

Steel Ø26×763 mm long post with Ø26 split socket on 160×170×30 mm foot (laminate 2×15 mm plywood and seal). Use four M6 through-bolts/washers to join socket and brace foot to fixed chassis with one padded clamp.
2× rectangular aluminum tube 25×20×2 cut 626 long; two 160×30×3 aluminum cross strips at ends; 8× M5 bolts/nuts/washers. Mount in 626×160 envelope and clear pan lip.
Split clamp matched to the mechanical mast with 95×120×26 block envelope. Two M6 bolts and backing strip to bracket. Two padded 80 mm throat F clamps and packers at bench edge.

465×243×30 sealed ply (laminate 2×15); four 12×12 nominal upright solid spacers at surveyed points; M5 feet or shims for fine height; four 120 mm and four 24 mm spacers or equivalent block stacks for off-nominal setups.
Two aluminum flat strap hold-downs 25×3×180 mm; padded bench clamps (2), stainless M5 hardware, non-slip closed-cell pads and rear crossbar.
Closed-cell PE/EVA foam; carve ellipsoids to raised.usda, head 190×150×155, torso 270×240×123; pillow 235×210×28. Secure with sealed fasteners or adhesive.

Two 3 mm matte strips cut to reach the surveyed Y positions; green band 23×20, 2 mm white centerline, magenta 22×5 front face, order mount 142×84×7 on 9×9 mm stem with source artwork 133×80 mm. Independent height ruler 1 mm graduation.
Shared straightedge, level, caliper, angle gauge, 30 mm spacer, phone(s) and tripod for continuous independent observation; speaker/LED flash for common time base.

Two 20×20×2 aluminum angles cut 240 long, two 90×30×3 steel outriggers, two 30×30 angle cleats and M5 through-bolts with washers. The cantilever and shelf move with the bed. Shelf, scale and slotted brackets are in water BOM.
25 mm solid aluminum square ×410; rebate 22 mm wide to world x399.5. For Ø25 round stock mill 2 mm full chord to the same datum and verify truck clearance. Existing mount and support in station BOM.

MGN09R rail length 240 with MGN09C carriage; installed height 10; block 20×28.9; mounting pattern 15×10 M3 depth 3. Verify dimensions of economy equivalent. HIWIN dimensional reference in mechanical build.
Sealed 9 mm birch plus 5.5–6 mm bridge and end pads; CAD carriage.step includes relief and water aperture. Wet weighed and ballasted. Ink and ruler witnesses included.
Cut rack.step from 6 mm 6061 plate. Two 95×12×6 aluminum bars with 79 mm centers; two Ø8 OD ×42 spacers; M3×60 flush screws, nuts and washers. M3 screws to solid mast. End pads and shims included.
3.00 mm stainless 304 stock; locking_yoke.step; 7×15×3 tongue; tap M2 fastener holes. Waterjet blank or bandsaw and file to profile.
machine/print acetal or solid PETG: pin_housing.step; pin_housing_cap.step; brake_tab.step. Dry sliding fit 6.24×3.24 around 6×3 strip. M2 screws for cover and tab, M3 for housing.

Compression spring free 20.0 mm; k=0.55 N/mm ±10%; OD ≤8.0 mm; ID ≥3.5 mm; solid height ≤9.0 mm; closed ends; working length 18 to 10. OD3 smooth guide post plus Ø8×0.8 washer. Buy 2–3 samples to select.
lift_neck.step solid PETG/acetal, rear M3 fixing; steel washers and through-bolt with prevailing nut for removable ballast, plus recessed brake/rotor trim weights.

Build tap_body.step and tap_rotor.step. Machine wet region in smooth acetal; dry parts PETG or acetal. Ø9 acetal plug stock including one spare. Two Ø5 OD nonmedical tails bore ≥3 and spring clips. Adhesive or mechanically clamped ferrules.

tap_liner.step: silicone 12 OD×8 ID×18; 45–55 Shore A. tap_crank.step: acetal keyed cam, M5×0.8 long-nose 1.6+ mm travel adjustable ball plunger target 5–9 N, locknut; Ø2 stop dowel, Ø1.6 dry roll pin, Ø2×17 thrust pin and shim washers. Spare liner.

M2/M3 screws, M3 countersinks, aluminum rail stops, non-slip locking nuts, thin 0.05–0.5 mm shims, sealing varnish, water-compatible lubricant for sleeve and marker paint. Fasteners must stay within defined grip clearances.

Caliper; ruler and square; 0–10 N force gauge or calibrated hanging weights; known 0.5 kg proof weight; 0.1 g scale; inspection light/camera; drilling/tapping and cutting tools. Excluded from consumables allowance.
80×80×140 internal acrylic reservoir; 3 mm walls and base; 5 mm flange/lid; 2 mm silicone gasket; M4 bolts×8; acrylic solvent cement; cut list in WATER_CALIBRATION.md
Clear rigid 30–32 mm ID vent tube length 170 mm with sealed OD-matched gland and collar; water outlet gasketed 6 mm hose barb bulkhead centered 12 mm above floor
120×120×6 mm shelf on two 125 mm slotted brackets on mannequin support; 95×95×15 mm corner-lipped cradle carried by weighing pan; slack hose; dry non-loadbearing tip guard
6 mm ID tee at source; branch pinch clamp; clear plastic standpipe ≥20 mm ID × 200 mm on vertically adjustable bracket; 6 mm ID feed and cap
600 mm silicone 6 mm ID × 9 mm OD; FEP FT2X3 2.00 mm ID × 3 mm OD stock 0.5 m; initial 180 mm; 2 mm steps when near target; covered clips; smooth bore external step-up compression unions
730 mm Adtech FT2.7X3.1 clear FEP 2.7 mm ID × 3.1 mm OD or same-bore equivalent; 3.3 mm minimum throat nonpinching clips and 25 mm minimum bend radius
4 mm ID × 6 mm OD silicone 300 mm total; slides over the two Ø5 mm OD beaded tails supplied under M09; smooth reducers; open acrylic spout 10 mm ID × 12 mm OD length 25 mm; bracket and clamps

Clear open funnel 18–22 mm mouth under spout; 12 mm clear moving spill chute; fixed ID ≥30 mm catch funnel and vented splash shroud; graded 16 mm internal width × 10 mm deep open trough in pitched legs of 69/256/60 mm with two sealed mitres and independent support brackets
Clear 250 mL open weighing cup; internal diameter 75 mm; inner height 60 mm; independent of fixed chute and guard
Each 2 kg or greater capacity; 0.1 g or finer display with verified ≤0.1 g incremental error and repeat spread at actual wet working load; continuous stable display or logged output
50 mL calibrated volumetric flask 0.1 mL or finer certified uncertainty; verified 10 g and 50 g weights with ≤0.02 g specified uncertainty; thermometer; ruler and protractor per station tools
EPDM washers; 6 mm and 4 mm hose spring clamps; clear sight-test-branch plug; retaining clips; source-side tubing reducers; cable ties outside fluid lumen
Ambient water; dry spill towels; fiducial markers; removable 5 mL external graduations calibrated by receiver scale
